$comment: Daily Dit Home card subtitle (gap row-25), consumed by BOTH ports' tests: ios MorseKitCheck, android and desktop GapLbDailyDitCardTest. Data, not code. Expected text is derived from the stated rule, not captured from an implementation: solved => '#N copied [at <wpm> WPM ]<g> guess(es) · <l> listen(s)' where the 'at <wpm> WPM ' part is dropped when no solved speed is recorded (never 'copied at  WPM'); playing with any guess or listen => '#N · <counts> so far'; playing untouched => 'Today's word in Morse — your speed, up to <fastest starting speed> WPM'. Counts are singular at exactly 1; wpm prints whole numbers without '.0'.
